hooks.command: changed=$(git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -E "[.]nix$" | grep -Ev "^secrets/"); if [ -n "$changed" ]; then printf "%s\n" "{\"systemMessage\": \"Nix files changed this turn — update the owning docs/ file (see CLAUDE.md § Routing). Do not run /init; it regenerates CLAUDE.md wholesale.\"}"; fi
